basic_details.job_title: ESIC Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 14 Specialist, Senior Resident and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview is on Friday, 27 November 2026, with reporting for document submission from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM at the Conference Hall, ESIC Hospital, Jaisalmer Road, Bikaner, Rajasthan; the notice prints no PIN code. The Medical Superintendent of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation hospital invites doctors for 6 Full Time Specialist posts, 6 Senior Resident posts and 2 Senior/Junior Resident posts against vacant GDMO posts, all on contract. Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM will not be considered.

important_instructions: Specialist engagement is purely contractual for one year, extendable up to maximum 3 years after break period, subject to requirement, satisfactory work or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Senior Resident engagement is contractual for one year, extendable up to maximum 3 years after break period, subject to requirement and satisfactory work performance report by the HOD and analysis by the Medical Superintendent. For Senior/Junior Resident against the GDMO post, services will be terminated immediately when a bond JR or regular incumbent joins; the last person will be terminated first. Selected candidates cannot claim regularization or service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical allowance, seniority and promotion. Private practice of any kind is not allowed. No hostel accommodation or quarters for contract Senior Residents. Security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- by Demand draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No. 1' payable at Bikaner, refundable after successful completion of contract and a 'No dues certificate'. It is forfeited if the candidate leaves before completing the contract period (minimum 1 year); SR/JR must give one month's notice or forfeit it. An agreement of Terms and Conditions must be signed on Rs 500/- non judicial stamp paper bought by the candidate before joining. The selected Specialist must hold a professional indemnity policy: minimum Rs.30 lac per annum for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeon, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.; Rs.20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologist, Obstetrician etc.; at least Rs.10 lacs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc. A copy of the policy and premium receipt is due within 7 days of engagement. Leave: Specialist and Senior Resident get 2.5 earned leave per month pro-rata and Sunday off; Senior/Junior Resident (GDMO post) gets 1 earned leave per month pro-rata and weekly off. No leave in advance and no encashment. No TA/DA is admissible for the walk-in interview or for joining. Absence for fifteen days without permission amounts to voluntary abandonment of engagement. Selection is subject to a medical fitness certificate, and registration with the Medical Council is needed before joining. The Competent Authority may fill all, or not fill any post, or cancel any vacancy or the interview at any stage. Corrigendum or extension, if any, will appear only on the ESIC website recruitments column.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bikaner Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties of the doctor will be as assigned by the Medical Superintendent. Work up to 48 hrs/week. Attend emergency duties and call duties as assigned by the Medical Superintendent or his representative, even on Sunday and Gazetted holiday. Perform floor duty in the emergency department or concerned department as instructed, and examine all kinds of patients preliminarily, apart from patients of their own specialty. Required to do duties in the emergency department and IPD floor duties; services may be used anywhere in the hospital based on need. Senior Residents with a post graduate degree in General Medicine / accident & emergency will be given preference; if not available, MBBS candidates with experience or good clinical knowledge in any discipline will be considered.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application filled properly in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-A), with the checklist signed. Two recent passport size photographs. One set of attested photocopies along with the originals for verification: proof of date of birth; SSC (Matriculation) certificate or equivalent; certificates of qualifications and marks sheets; MBBS mark sheet and degree certificate; PG Degree / Diploma certificate. Caste / category certificate for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer) or EWS in the prescribed proforma, and a self-undertaking for OBC (non-creamy layer) status in the prescribed format. Aadhaar card, PAN card, experience certificate, MCI/RMC registration copy. NOC from present employer (if applicable). The checklist also lists MBBS and PG attempt certificates. Candidates whose original documents are deposited in a Medical College to complete a bond period must bring a certificate from the Principal of that college and an NOC from that institution stating it has no objection to their joining ESIC Hospital, Bikaner if selected. The notice says an application without the relevant documents may lead to rejection of candidature in the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Bikaner, between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM on 27 November 2026 to submit documents. The notice states that minimum 50% marks in the interview is compulsory for selection, and the decision of the selection board is final. Selected candidates must report for duty immediately or on the date in the offer letter, failing which the appointment is deemed cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the ESIC Bikaner walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27/11/2026 (Friday) at the Conference Hall, ESIC Hospital, Jaisalmer Road, Bikaner, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Reporting for documents submission is from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM. No candidate who reports after 11 AM on 27/11/2026 will be considered for interview.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 14 posts: 6 Full Time Specialists, 6 Senior Residents and 2 Senior/Junior Residents against vacant GDMO posts (01 ST and 01 UR).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Specialist?
faq.answer: A PG Degree or equivalent with 03-year post-PG experience, or a PG Diploma with 05-year post-PG experience, in the respective specialty from a recognized university, with valid MCI / State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Senior Resident and Senior/Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Senior Resident needs a PG Degree or diploma / DNB in the concerned specialty. For the GDMO post, a PG Degree or diploma / DNB is preferred; otherwise MBBS candidates with experience or good clinical knowledge in any discipline will be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Specialist: age not exceeding 69 years. Senior Resident and Senior/Junior Resident: upper age limit 45 years. Age is counted as on the date of interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Specialist gets Rs 121408 per month consolidated. Senior Resident is paid as per 7th CPC level 11. Senior/Junior Resident (GDMO post) gets consolidated Rs 1,21,048 per month, revised from time to time as ESIC HQ instructions.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, all posts are purely contractual. Specialists and Senior Residents are engaged for one year, extendable up to maximum 3 years after break period; GDMO-post Senior/Junior Residents are engaged for 1 year.

faq.question: Q9. Is a security deposit required?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must submit Rs. 25,000/- as Demand draft in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No. 1' payable at Bikaner. It is refundable after completion of the contract and a 'No dues certificate'.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no TA/DA is admissible for the walk-in interview or for joining the post.
